title: Burmese–Siamese War (1775–1776)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Burmese–Siamese War (1775–1776)", at revision 1370607033, opens: "The Burmese–Siamese War (1775–1776) or Maha Thiha Thura's Invasion of Siam or Athi Wungyi's War was a major military conflict between the Konbaung dynasty of Burma and the Thonburi Kingdom of Siam." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q1758978, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "war between the Konbaung Dynasty of Burma and Thonburi Kingdom of Siam". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (named for this item in data/imports/wikidata-seeds.json): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
